name: AI Lossless Cut
short: Cut pieces out of a file without re-encoding it
description: Cuts the pieces you mark out of a video or sound file without re-encoding it: each piece keeps exactly the original's quality, and it takes seconds. A keyframe cut starts each piece on the keyframe at or just before your In (nothing is re-encoded); a smart cut starts exactly on your In by re-encoding only the few frames up to the next keyframe (H.264 and HEVC). Each piece is its own file; they can also be joined into one.

options.name: all_tracks
options.label: Keep every track (all the sound tracks, timecode)

options.name: join
options.label: Also join the pieces into one file
